newsitem.title: USA: SBC unit to sell $400 mln in debt -- sources.
newsitem.headline: SBC unit to sell $400 mln in debt -- sources.

text.p: Southwest Bell Telephone, a unit of SBC Communications Inc, is expected to sell $400 million in debt in a two-part offering via Goldman Sachs & Co as early as Tuesday, market sources said.
As currently structured, the deal will include $250 million in 10-year debt and $150 million in 30-year debt.
The 30-year tranche will be non-callable for 10 years, the sources said.
Price talk for the 10-year tranche was heard at 37-40 basis points over Treasuries. Price talk on the 30-year tranche was heard at 77-80 basis points over Treasuries.
Market sources said the deal is rated AA3/AA.
